voices.note: the Sages of the Teruma mishna, 22b.2

props.gloss_en: Rav Huna: I heard two skeins, one of warp and one of woof, and I cannot explain
R' Yochanan: I heard three skeins -- warp, woof, and the large skein of the sack-makers -- and I cannot explain
a woman's [fetus] -- like the warp skein
an animal's [fetus] -- like the woof skein

a clod coming from a beit haperas or from the land of the nations -- its measure is like the large skein of the sack-makers, the seal of the martzufin, found on the upper side of the stopper of a Lachmit jug
one who buys brine from an am ha'aretz brings it into contact with water, and it is pure
if water is the majority -- since contact was made, they are purified
and if brine is the majority -- brine is not susceptible to impurity
what is there? because of that minority of water -- it is nullified in the majority
R' Yirmeya: they taught this only for dipping one's bread in it
but for a pot -- no: the kind found its kind and revived
impurity that was nullified returns and revives
a se'a of impure teruma that fell into a hundred of pure chullin -- R' Eliezer: let [a se'a] be lifted and rot, for I say the se'a that fell is the se'a that came up
the Sages: it comes up, and is eaten dry or roasted, or kneaded with fruit juice, or divided into doughs, provided there is not an egg-bulk in one place
and it was taught on it: those chullin according to R' Eliezer -- they are eaten dry or roasted, or kneaded with fruit juice, or divided into doughs, provided there is not an egg-bulk in one place

Ulla: what is the reason? a decree lest he bring a kav of impure chullin from elsewhere and a kav and a little of this, thinking he has nullified them in the majority -- and since there is that bit, the kind found its kind and revived

schemas.gloss_en: ממה נפשך: if water is the majority, contact purified it; if brine is the majority, brine is not susceptible and the minority of water is nullified in it -- either way the brine is pure

deflected_by.gloss_en: אם טומאה עוררת טומאה, טהרה עוררת טומאה? -- in the teruma case impure chullin revive the impurity; in the brine the pot's water is pure
